t: Hold back this young man on my behalf, lest he causes my ruin, because I am loath to send these two (al-Hassan and al-Husayn) towards death, lest the descending line of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his descendants) is cut away by their death. Al-Sayyid al-Radi says : Amir al-Mu'minin's words " amliku anni hadha'l-ghulam " " i.e. Hold back this young man on my behalf " represent the highest and the most eloquent form of expression.
